title: Password Checker
hints: Loop over the characters with charAt(i) and use boolean flags: hasUpper, hasLower, hasDigit.
Character.isUpperCase, Character.isLowerCase and Character.isDigit test a single char.
After the loop, print one line for each rule that failed, in the order of the table. If none failed, print Strong password.
